nominal_error_budget.interpretation: design_budget_only; the scaled alpha deliberately exceeds it and drift remains

selection_basis.data: pulse-stable-candidate campaign (315 pairs, fast-scoring timing) and its normal, replayed (development for the next run)
selection_basis.rule: pre-registered rule v2 (SENTINEL_PULSE_STATUS 5.8d: < 2 s preferred, <= 3 s acceptable)
known_gaps: normal alert burden 6.5 episodes/replica-hour is ~65x the 0.1/h budget; not solved by thresholds
benign new-process launches are flagged at 94%; the detector separates new activity, not malicious activity

output_mode: shadow_preview_only; never emits alert or enforcement
evaluation_requirements: fresh normal soak plus fresh attack campaign with benign-exec controls; fast scoring; report idle and benign controls separately; do not tune after outcomes
